AI-Buzz.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
AI-Buzz.summary: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.

AI-Buzz.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
AI-Buzz.summary: A new study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising questions about preparedness as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.

AI-Buzz.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
AI-Buzz.summary: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

AI-Buzz.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
AI-Buzz.summary: Nvidia continues to pour money into data center development — just as AI data centers bring lots of money into Nvidia.

AI-Buzz.title: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button

AI-Buzz.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
AI-Buzz.summary: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.

World Conflicts.title: Palestinian teen killed in Israeli raid buried in Occupied West Bank
World Conflicts.summary: Hundreds attended the funeral of 14-year-old Islam Ahmad Maher Ajouri, who was killed by Israeli gunfire during a raid.
